test_title: PYST 8: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 18th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/400089adfabb90db8f92e33cb0c555bd2d558ac31774908e4fd3c387f99f91dc.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) The triangle rotates in a clockwise direction in box each corner and the triangle convert into a square shape and square shape converts into a triangle shape.

2) Line rotate in a clockwise direction and one by one line increase.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b8d8abe076a2a624232498f526df86d53cf0874dee3ef84fa96d387265b30f7.png] 

Final series is

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69b8baf7632cb41517ace219ce4aff2cb1be0ed1da6a0426afa7bed992346308.png] 

Hence, **‘option 3’** is the correct answer.
